text:
Sam Patel: Observed a perf regression after the kernel-selection tweak earlier today — prefix cache hit-rate dropped ~35% on p95 workloads. baseline traces attached?

Eva Gomez: saw that. p95 latency up ~120ms on 2K request burst. Repro script I used: `./scripts/repro_prefix_hit.sh --model xformer-v2 --q=2000`

Mike Chen: What's the kernel change? Was it the fused-attn fallback for short sequences? commit `1a2b3c`?

Ani Rao: Yep. commit `1a2b3c` switched the batching heuristic to prefer larger batches -> more KV eviction churn. I suspect warmup/prefill windows are getting pushed past the hot prefix lifetime.

Sam Patel: Heap/frag numbers: GPU cache occupancy oscillating 70% -> 92% then OOMs in some pods. `nvidia-smi` shows memory fragmentation high. Profile (perf) shows heavy memcpy on the `kv_evict` path.

Eva Gomez: Also saw a key cardinality spike when we enabled the prefetcher rewrite yesterday. Many keys are near-duplicates (trace ids, request ids appended) — keying not canonicalized -> duplicate entries -> hit-rate drop.

Mike Chen: Quick proposals: 1) Canonicalize prompt keying (strip trace/request ids) 2) Increase TTL for hot prefixes 3) Soften LRU on GPU cache (age-bucket smoothing / hysteresis).

Ani Rao: I can try tuning eviction knobs: bump `eviction_coalesce_ms` 10 -> 50 and `soft_cap_ratio` 0.85 -> 0.92 to reduce eviction thrash and avoid immediate compaction churn.

Sam Patel: Ran a 2h A/B locally: TTL bump to 60s improved hit-rate +18% and p95 down ~60ms. Memory usage stayed high and fragmentation persisted — compaction/defrag needed.

deploy-bot: Rolled back runtime v1.3.2 -> v1.3.1 at 2467890200 due to OOM alerts on the dedicated pool. :warning:

Eva Gomez: Can we add telemetry probes: emit per-prefix key-length + normalized-hash histogram and a `kv_eviction_reason` tag (capacity vs frag vs policy)? This will help separate soft-evict vs forced evict.

Mike Chen: I'll add a lightweight runtime probe and counter for `duplicate_key_drops` and a small jemalloc/alloc_stats report on the CPU side to correlate fragmentation.

Ani Rao: Proposed experiment plan: (A) key canonicalization + TTL=60s, (B) tune soft_cap & coalesce as above, (C) temporarily disable the new batching fallback kernel. Run each on a 24h dedicated pool, compare hit-rate, p95, and OOM counts.

Sam Patel: I'll collect results into the perf dashboard and pin tests to the `xformer-v2@1.3.1` model. Keeping rollback until experiment B completes sounds safe. Anyone object? :thumbsup:

Eva Gomez: +1

Mike Chen: +1
